plugins.name: autonomous-appbuilder
plugins.description: App builder: idea → PRD → design → scaffold → env → execute → review → smoke, via a main-loop orchestrator OR two deterministic Workflow engines — `build-app-workflow` (the pipeline as code) and `forge` (walk-away builder with a continuous closed verification loop that drives every flow until it's first-shot-verified). Cross-tool (Claude Code + Codex).

plugins.name: immortals
plugins.description: Autonomous life cycle runner with multi-world orchestration. Spawns Claude agents as mythological beings that explore, work, and pass wisdom across lives. Hot-reloadable config, hand-of-god universe orchestrator, optional oversight agent.
